title: Kusanagi Nene — Backstage Operator〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Hello.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ah! Nene!
Hi ho!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? You're alone today?
Where are Tsukasa and Rui?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They, um, will be late because of detention, so yes, I came here by myself...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Both of them have detention together?
Do I smell an incident?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa almost got blown up in the swimming pool... He's fine, but the explosion created a plume of water. Because of that, they had to stay back for detention.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Explosions and plumes of water?!
That sounds so fun! I'll have to ask them about it later!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, let's get the place ready while we wait for them! Starting with the cleanup!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah, okay, I just have to wipe the floor...right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! Thanks!
Oh, and don't mind that creaky spot over there♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, got it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? This stain won't come off.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's been there for a long time. It won't come off!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Has this line stain been here for a long time too?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, that too! I've tried a few different methods to remove them, but they just won't go away.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm... It may be time to apply some wax over the floor. The coating over there has come off. We'll need to fix it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Emu is so serious about this...
Come to think of it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This place is important to you and your grandfather, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's right!
Grandpa was the one who made this stage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've watched so many shows here and saw it transform into all sorts of different worlds before and after the performances!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Different worlds...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! That's why I want to keep putting big, bright smiles on people's faces from the worlds we create on this stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is that...your dream?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
What about you, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's your dream to become a musical actress, right? What made you have that dream?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, I guess... It was because of the musical Rui and I watched together when we were little?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was so moved by that musical because everything inside, from the singing to the dancing and acting was amazing. I wanted to be able to sing and dance like that one day too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! And that's why you wanted to become a stage actress.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes... Rui also started wanting to become a stage director because of that musical too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sharing the same dream after watching the same show... How wonderhoy-ful is that?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm... When you put it that way, it does seem wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And then?
And then what happened?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Rui and I started learning about stage shows on our own, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, but what did you do, exactly?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We watched different musicals, movies, and tried to put into practice what we had learned...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa... I always thought you sang so well.
So it's because you've been practicing since you were little!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu?
What are you so happy about?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm happy because I got to talk so much with you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What about you? Are you happy?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. I'm happy too, I think.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A message from...Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
<We just ended here.
We're heading over there as quickly as we can now.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What is it? What did he say?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He said they're heading over here now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's fun when everyone practices together, but...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (For now, I hope I can talk to Emu for just a bit longer.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
<You don't have to rush or anything.
Take your time.>
Send.
